THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE  207

9:30 A.M.—Registrations. L. J. Reynolds, Chairman; Miss Mattie Lee Boyd, Assistant.

11:00 A.M.—Outdoor Program, direction of J. Wesley Moulton, Superintendent Savoy School, assisted by Sam McKee and Tobe Hughes.

12:00 Noon—Dutch treat luncheon, each attendant furnishing his own meal.


FORMAL OPENING OF REUNION

2:00 P.M.—Meeting Called to Order.

            E. A. McMahon, General Chairman.

            Invocation, Rev. J. H. Henderson, Waldron, Arkansas.

            Address of Welcome, Hon. J. B. May, Mayor of Savoy.

            Response, Hon. Gyp P. Webb, Sherman, Texas.

            Reports of Committees on Arrangements.

            Report of Ex-Students Organization.

            Acknowledgment of Courtesies.

            General Business.

5:00 P.M.—Adjournment.


BANQUET

August 6, 1938—8:00 P.M.

PROGRAM

Toastmaster, Gus W. Thomasson, Dallas.

Invocation, Judge Oliver C. Mulkey, Commerce, Texas.

Sing Song, led by Ben Halsell, Bonham, Texas.

Greetings, W. P. Carter, President Savoy School Board.
